payload.core_mechanism_summary: Keep only max index per value, sort by index descending, then for each i find the first j with gcd=1 to maximize sum; prune when 2*ai ≤ best.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts distinct values by their last occurrence index to greedily pick the largest index pair. For each i, it takes the first coprime j (largest remaining index) and breaks, exploiting the descending order.
